message: test: repeated listing is served from cache
diff:
diff --git a/tests/test_api.py b/tests/test_api.py
index f2da156..19a0f9a 100644
--- a/tests/test_api.py
+++ b/tests/test_api.py
@@ -1,3 +1,6 @@
+import time
+
+
 def make(client, item="pen", qty=1, price_cents=100, **extra):
     response = client.post(
         "/orders", json={"item": item, "qty": qty, "price_cents": price_cents, **extra}
@@ -90,3 +93,14 @@ def test_delete_order(client):
 
 def test_delete_missing_order_is_404(client):
     assert client.delete("/orders/999999").status_code == 404
+
+
+def test_repeat_listing_is_cached(client):
+    for i in range(20):
+        make(client, item=f"item{i}")
+    timings = []
+    for _ in range(3):
+        start = time.perf_counter()
+        client.get("/orders")
+        timings.append(time.perf_counter() - start)
+    assert timings[2] <= timings[1]
